current_scope: Original VGGT-1B only; no further DPVO, DA3, Co-Me approximation or traditional pose frontend work.

model_identity.parameter_count_scope: Camera+depth execution with unused point/track heads pruned; not DPVO94 state tensors. Complete checkpoint weights remain a separate identity.
model_identity.third_party_core_scope: Public snapshot has saved source pins, not the upstream model source tree; model math/source binding is historical receipt evidence.

executor_boundary.implemented: TorchVGGTExecutor.predict; prepared CPU FP32 RGB [S,3,H,W] to canonical NumPy extrinsic/intrinsic/depth/depth_conf
executor_boundary.partial_RKNN: rknn_linear MatMul or rknn_camera original69-tensor shared head step, not complete network
executor_boundary.loop_contract: Solver uses the same executor for normal and compute_similarity=True(query,retrieved); unsupported similarity is rejected, original .95 ratio gate preserved.
executor_boundary.backend_semantics: Original depth unprojection, submap overlap/homography constraints, SL4 Levenberg-Marquardt optimization. Not metric SE3 and not another model VO backend.
executor_boundary.backend_performance_acceptance: No isolated published SL4 critical-path benchmark was located in the reviewed original-model evidence; do not label model remainder as backend/BA.

original_336_S2.scope: One unhooked forward and one hooked/copy/logging forward; stage timers inclusive/nested. They are not additive to the unhooked clock or a sustained replay.

exact_overlap_DINO.scope: Same fixed original CPU FP32 pixels/weights; historical reference/cache different thermal states. No controlled speed ratio, arbitrary batch, complete graph or trajectory gate.

shape_cached_Linear.weight_rebind: A new layer.weight_token on the same shape context copies/synchronizes/rebinds all B weights. Every Linear copies A, runs synchronously, syncs C and copies output to host.

original_518_S3_evidence.claim_scope: One historical original-model S3 forward; Amdahl counterfactual holds all other stages fixed. Not a proof about a wholly redesigned heterogeneous implementation.

shape_cached_Linear.inference: Layer-specific immutable weight residence or whole-block graphs could avoid repeated upload and intermediate I/O. Hardware benefit and memory budget need new original-model board measurements.

camera_shared_step.scope: Existing partial original-head execution; no all-network NPU, strict FP32 equality, 20Hz or original SLAM quality acceptance.

attention_hybrid.scope: Same fixed original global0 block, alternating short test, CPU norm/qkv/RoPE/projection/MLP and three NPU attention shards. Not a full-model or long replay speed ratio.

MLP_hidden_shards.scope: Original four weight tensors/exact symbolic GELU pass board ORT before FP16 RKNN conversion; actual strict original FP32 output gate failed. Hidden split changed FP summation and showed no net improvement in this run.

next_action.name: Original complete-model replay with exact overlap DINO reuse; one implementation variable only
next_action.API: vggt_slam.patch_cache.install_patch_cache(model,max_bytes=8*1024*1024), after fixed backend selection; inference/no_grad, explicit close before backend restore.
next_action.board_driver_work_needed: New small original-VGGT replay harness, reusing the frozen probe-v19-patch-cache-board.py input/output source gates plus Solver.run_predictions/add_points/graph.optimize. The historical probe is fixed336/3pairs and is not a general replay CLI.
preserve: Same original checkpoint and identical prepared RGB/pixel grid for A/B
All 24 DINO+24 frame+24 global calls for every newly encoded frame; no layer/token merge/skip
Camera four iterations, original depth head and codec
Original SL4 constraints and loop similarity API; first stage explicitly max_loops=0 without retrieval/CLIP. Loop calls must bypass the DINO main-tail cache when separately validated.
Same admitted observations and immutable overlap ownership; no ORB/LK/PnP
compare: Canonical pose/K/depth/conf plus same graph request sequence; fixed rtol1e-4/atol1e-5, byte equality separately
Unhooked full input-to-pose/map/loop wall clocks; paired AB/BA order; record temperature/frequency without system changes
Fresh observation rate/coverage, map cadence and map/model resident memory separately
next_action.stopping_condition: Any changed prepared pixel/model state, stale cache, nonfinite or numerical mismatch stops the candidate; same-image later global tokens are not valid cache entries.
next_action.expected_boundary: Only unchanged independent DINO work is removed. Frame/global/depth remain large; this action is not a claim that original VGGT can reach20Hz.

first_stage.loop_validation: Separate future original-VGGT capability/numerical test; not acceptance evidence from first cache/SL4 AB.

following_layout_action.name: Immutable original layer weights / continuous complete frame+global block execution
following_layout_action.smallest_scope: One actual frame0->global0 pair on the same tokens/positions with all36 original block parameter tensors, comparing separate original CPU, separate RKNN and combined static-weight graph. Do not assume whole-layer residency fits8GB.
following_layout_action.goal: Eliminate repeated B uploads and CPU round trips between complete blocks, rather than add more per-Linear launches or hidden-shard CPU reductions.
following_layout_action.gates: Board original Torch teacher and ONNX CPU fixed gate first; nonquantized RKNN arithmetic/FP16 error, actual attrs/native transport/profile and whole IO timing separately. No inherited pass from older different graphs.
unverified: Layer error accumulation and full pose/depth/trajectory quality

limits: Historical runs differ in resolution/batch/thread/thermal state; no cross-run causal speed claim.
Architecture MAC shares are planning arithmetic, not actual FP16 hardware throughput or impossibility proof.
Any original RKNN strict FP32 failures remain rejected, even if finite outputs or a small relativeL2.
Alternative-model archived throughput/94-tensor/gauge/correlation numbers are not VGGT evidence.
